model_details.name: adult / mlp
model_details.title: Small neural network, 32-16 hidden units (black box)

probability_calibration.method: Platt scaling on the calibration split

intended_use.primary: Demonstration and evaluation of explanation, fairness and uncertainty tooling on a public benchmark.
intended_use.out_of_scope: Any real decision about people. These models are not validated for deployment.

training_data.name: adult
training_data.title: Adult / Census Income (1994)
training_data.source: OpenML dataset 'adult' (data id 1590), originally UCI Machine Learning Repository, fetched with scikit-learn fetch_openml
training_data.version: OpenML version 2; raw table sha256 d273d956c28eba72
training_data.licence: Public (UCI repository, CC BY 4.0 for the Adult dataset)
training_data.description: 1994 US census extract. Task: predict income above 50K. Nine of the fourteen columns are used, with categorical columns reduced to binary indicators.
training_data.sensitive_use: audit only; never a model input
limitations: Collected in 1994; reflects historical labour-market inequality, so subgroup gaps are largely a property of the data, not only of the model.
Sex is recorded as a binary attribute; no other identities are represented.
Proxies for sex (for example marital status and hours per week) remain in the features.
Not a decision-ready dataset: a benchmark for demonstration only.

splits.method: stratified on the label; one fixed seed

explanations.target: raw model log-odds of the positive class

limitations: Collected in 1994; reflects historical labour-market inequality, so subgroup gaps are largely a property of the data, not only of the model.
Sex is recorded as a binary attribute; no other identities are represented.
Proxies for sex (for example marital status and hours per week) remain in the features.
Not a decision-ready dataset: a benchmark for demonstration only.
Metrics are from a single train/test split; no confidence intervals are given for accuracy.
Conformal guarantees are marginal and assume exchangeable data; they say nothing about drift.
ethical_considerations: Subgroup gaps measured here describe this dataset and this model, not causes.
The sensitive attribute is used for auditing only and is not a model input; proxies may remain.
Passing an audit does not make a model fair; failing one is a prompt to investigate.
